normalization: Choose the 20 explicitly matched candidates in fixture-source-analysis.json; retain original condition/token IDs and titles.
Match Gamma conditionId to CLOB condition_id, then the explicit USDC reward asset entry. The saved sampling page is partial; absence never means rewards disabled.
Score float fields follow gamma.py parse_market at the recorded upstream commit, including CLOB 24h volume preference and rounded taker fee basis points.
Execution tick/minimum fields are decimal strings, converted to Decimal by test loading; scoring reference values remain floats.
Political comes from the captured CLOB Politics tag. accepting_orders requires explicit true in both captures. Missing inPlay remains null/unknown.
Synthetic controls and counterexamples retain the base condition ID, carry distinct fixture IDs, and enumerate every changed field relative to their named base.
